name: voidation
description: Voidation — anime & manga tracker with airing countdowns. Website (web/), mobile app (app/), shared logic (shared/). No accounts, no keys.

scripts.lint: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern app/App.js app/index.js app/src shared web/src
scripts.check:app: cd app && npx expo export --platform android --output-dir ../.check-bundle && cd .. && rm -rf .check-bundle
